# The Influential Spirit: book facts

> A 30-day Christian devotional by Pastor Eryeza Kalalu about the formation of the person behind the influence. This file gathers the facts about the book in one place, for AI assistants and search engines. Last updated: 16 November 2026.

## At a glance

- Title: The Influential Spirit
- Subtitle: 30 Days to a Life of Kingdom Authority, Character, and Marketplace Impact
- Author and narrator: Pastor Eryeza Kalalu (Kampala and Entebbe, Uganda)
- Edition: Second edition, 2026. The first edition was titled Becoming an Influence.
- Series: Volume I of The Deep Encounter Library
- Published: 30 September 2026. © 2026 Eryeza Kalalu, Kampala, Uganda.
- Language: English. Scripture quotations are from the New King James Version (NKJV).
- Length: 30 daily readings in four parts, with a preface, an introduction and an epilogue. The Reader Edition PDF is 142 pages.
- Time each day: ten to fifteen minutes.
- Formats: PDF (designed for phone, tablet and computer), EPUB (Apple Books, Kindle via Send to Kindle, Google Play Books), and an audiobook read by the author (about 4 hours 48 minutes).
- Where to buy: https://eryezakalalu.com/influential-spirit/ (instant digital delivery through Selar).

## What the book is about

The Influential Spirit asks what kind of person God can trust with influence. Influence here has nothing to do with a title: it is the ordinary responsibility of a Christian at work, in business, in ministry, at home and in church, where other people are already watching. The book puts formation first and the platform second: the Spirit's work in a person is what carries the work through them. It is written for a time when visibility is easily mistaken for spiritual maturity.

## Who it is for

- Christians at work, in business, in the marketplace or in public service
- Pastors, ministry leaders, managers and team leaders
- Anyone who wants a short daily devotional on character, integrity and perseverance
- Small groups, church teams and workplace fellowships (with the six-session Group Study Guide)

## The shape of each day

Each of the thirty days has a Scripture (NKJV), an honest reading of it, a reflection question, a practice for the day, a prayer and a declaration.

## The thirty days

Part I · The Invitation
1. Following to Lead
2. Ordinary Is Not an Excuse
3. Light for the Next Step
4. Significant in a Crowd
5. Bold Sheep

Part II · The Transformation
6. Imitate Me
7. Bury My Father
8. The Departure
9. The Circle of Influence
10. Holy and Lonely
11. Death of the Selfie
12. The Towel Strategy
13. The Hidden Engine
14. Stormproof
15. Wax Fruit

Part III · The Crucible
16. Perfume, Not Poison
17. An Excellent Spirit
18. A Loose Rudder
19. Son of Encouragement
20. In the Waiting Room

Part IV · The Multiplication
21. The Golden Vessel
22. Out of the Boat
23. The Invisible Foundation
24. The River and the Reservoir
25. Past "the Wall"
26. The Trap of Praise
27. Resilience in the Valley
28. God's Relay
29. Fueled by the Spirit
30. The Eternal Perspective

## Common questions

- Do I need to be a leader to read it? No. Influence here has nothing to do with a title. It is about ordinary responsibility, character and the people who are already watching your life.
- Is it a leadership book? It is more than that. It is a devotional about spiritual formation; leadership, work and influence are where that formation is tested.
- Will it work if I am not in ministry? Yes. Most of the book is written to the person whose pulpit is a desk, a classroom, a clinic, a business, a boardroom or a kitchen table.
- How long is each day? Ten to fifteen minutes.
- Is there an audiobook? Yes, read by the author, in the Formation Bundle and the Complete Formation Edition.
- Is there a journal? Yes, in the Complete Formation Edition.
- Can I use it with a group? Yes. The Formation Bundle and the Complete Formation Edition include the six-session Group Study Guide.
- How is it different from Becoming an Influence? Becoming an Influence focused on God's call for us to lead. This expanded second edition asks what manner of person we must become to represent Christ in modern society: formation first, then the platform.
- Can I pay with M-Pesa or mobile money? Yes, at checkout on Selar.

## About the author

Pastor Eryeza Kalalu is a pastor, author and Bible teacher in Kawuku, Entebbe, Uganda. He leads Rivers of Life Healing Centre, hosts the Devotion In Season podcast (weekly on Sundays and a short daily devotional on weekday mornings) and writes the Eryeza Writes letter. More: https://eryezakalalu.com/about/

Unscripted Christmas: 24 Days with Christ for the Christmas You Are Actually Having. An Advent devotional for grief, money stress, family tension and loneliness. On pre-order at https://eryezakalalu.com/christmas/ until its release on 28 November 2026.
